rationale: Splunk’s November 4 Product Status update lists UF, Cloud Platform, ES, ITSI, SOAR Cloud, SOAR and SOAR Connectors as unaffected. Enterprise 10.0 and lower is affected through the bundled Node.js runtime, with 10.2+ recommended for that runtime. The advisory separately says all Enterprise versions include vulnerable Visual Exporter and offers disabling or removing it as a potential mitigation. SOAR Automation Broker is affected; the advisory gives no exact affected/fixed Broker build. Observability Cloud and OpenTelemetry Collectors remain under investigation. HF evaluation depends on the installed Enterprise-package components. The historical October assessment is retained.

versions: Enterprise 10.2 or higher as bundled-runtime mitigation
Enterprise all versions as scoped by the Visual Exporter advisory footnote
audiences: Customers and documentation readers evaluating the stated decision
exclusions: No exact Broker patch or package version, installed HF component, new Enterprise 10.0 patch date or customer authorization is inferred.

remainingConcerns: Carry the component-scoped revision into source annotations and eligible report guidance. Check for an exact Broker remediation, preserve the advisory’s present limits, and validate delivery before activation.

evidence.section: Description; Product Status > Under Investigation, Affected Products and Unaffected Products; November 4 Changelog
evidence.statement: Revised status and separate Enterprise runtime, Visual Exporter, Automation Broker and investigation scopes.
